---
title: "A random-criterion representation of weighted risk"
subtitle: "4.8 · after the postrank theory book, ch. 11–12"
description: "Drawing one criterion for a fixed report reproduces its weighted risk on average."
---

Fix a grade report first, then draw one criterion with probabilities equal to the loss weights. Evaluating the whole report on that criterion reproduces direct weighted risk.

```{=html}
<div id="app" class="prx-app column-page"></div>

<script>window.__prxApp = PRX["criterion-mixture"].mountWidget(document.getElementById("app"));</script>
```

## Numerical illustrations {#what-to-try}

- **Weighted report.** Report 1/1/1/1/2/3 has risk .0933 from contributions .0453 and .0480.
- **Certain opposition.** Withholding costs .300 while **Data** shows strict directions cost .500.
- **Three actions tie.** All 3 reports tie at weighted risk .500.
- **Two against one.** Risk is .333; **Data** shows standalone costs .333, .667, and .400.
- **Zero error weight.** **Data** shows directional minimum 0 and chance 0 on risk 1.0000.
- **No-cap coherence.** Among 4,683 reports, 1/2/2/3/4/5 states 14 pairs at risk .127 (**Data**: errors .380, .381 above $\tau$ .35).

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="In postrank"}
The fixed default report reproduces the two calculations; small floating-point rounding differences do not change
their algebraic identity.

```r
library(postrank)
ev <- postrank_evaluate(c(A=1L,B=1L,C=1L,D=1L,E=2L,F=3L), pr_tutorial$two, weights=c(score_A=.5,score_B=.5), tau=.2)
sum(c(.5,.5)*ev$criterion_risk); ev$weighted_risk
```
:::

<details>
<summary>Mixture independence and KRW correspondence</summary>

The criterion draw is independent of the targets conditional on the supplied information, with probabilities given by the loss weights. In postrank, a strict direction counts as wrong when target values are equal. Correspondence to KRW's strict-count objective requires matching the law, targets, orientation, units, and report family, plus the affine and equality conditions of that result.

</details>
